description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractLoanRepaymentDueEvent' which implements an 'Event' interface parameterized with 'LoanRepaymentDueDataV1'. It provides methods to retrieve the data class and an ID extractor function for loan repayment due events in the context of a messaging system within the loan module.

classes.name: AbstractLoanRepaymentDueEvent
classes.description: An abstract class for events related to loan repayment due data, providing common implementations for event data class retrieval and ID extraction.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of LoanRepaymentDueDataV1 used in the event.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Provides a function to extract the loan ID from LoanRepaymentDueDataV1 instances.
